disorder-name.detail: First-episode major depressive disorder clinical cohort
disorder-name.supporting_text: Methods: To further investigate this question, we compared 369 first-episode MDD patients (mean age = 35 years (sd = 12), 249 females; 283 early onset, 86 mid-to-late onset) from the open-source REST meta-MDD database closely matched for age and gender to 490 never-depressed individuals (mean age = 37 years (sd = 14); 309 females) using Z -scores obtained from normative neuroanatomical modeling to assess individual variability in CC (sub)volumes.
